thag3.12:1.1: Paṇḍitaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ alamatthavicintakaṃ pañca kāmaguṇā loke sammohā pātayiṃsu maṃ. || ||
thag3.12:2.1: pakkhanno Māravisaye daḷhasallasamappito asakkhiṃ Maccurājassa ahaṃ pāsā pamuccituṃ. || ||
thag3.12:3.1: sabbe kāmā pahīnā me, bhavā sabbe padālitā, vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo 'ti. || || Uttarapālo thero.
